title: Service deployment conformance
description: Per-service status of every service deployment workflow step, as last recorded by Collect Service Conformance (the only writer). Plan 15; change service-deployment-workflow task 7.5.

panels.title: Current failed step states
panels.description: Count of unique service and step pairs whose newest state across all statuses in the last 45 minutes is fail. The state is reduced first; a later pass or skip replaces an older failure. This is current recorded workflow state, not a count of new failure events or overall service health. With valid inventory markers and no currently failed steps, the fallback returns an unlabeled zero; with no recent valid marker the panel shows no data.

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time({job="agent-cloud-conformance", step!="none"} | json state_code | unwrap state_code | __error__="" [45m]) by (service, step) == bool 0) or (sum(last_over_time({job="agent-cloud-conformance", step="none", status=~"^(no_history|has_history|history_incomplete)$"} | json | inventory_code=~"^(0|1|2)$" | marker_time_seconds=~"^[0-9]+$" | __error__="" | unwrap inventory_code | __error__="" [45m]) by (service) * 0))

panels.title: Services tracked

targets.expr: count(count by (service) (count_over_time({job="agent-cloud-conformance", step="none", status=~"^(no_history|has_history|history_incomplete)$"} | json | inventory_code=~"^(0|1|2)$" | marker_time_seconds=~"^[0-9]+$" | __error__="" [45m])))

panels.description: Distinct services with a valid inventory marker in the last 45 minutes, including services with no workflow history. Invalid marker bodies are excluded. No valid marker means no data.

panels.title: Latest inventory marker age

targets.expr: min(last_over_time({job="agent-cloud-conformance", step="none", status=~"^(no_history|has_history|history_incomplete)$"} | json | inventory_code=~"^(0|1|2)$" | marker_time_seconds=~"^[0-9]+$" | __error__="" | label_format age_seconds=`{{sub (unixEpoch now) .marker_time_seconds}}` | unwrap age_seconds | __error__="" [45m]))

panels.description: Age in seconds of the newest valid collector inventory marker, calculated from its numeric body timestamp. The 30-minute stale threshold is calibrated from 12 successful collector runs on 2026-10-10 (11.7–11.9-minute task durations; 14.8–15.1-minute completion gaps). Recalibrate from future run receipts; this is not a lifetime timing guarantee. No valid marker within 45 minutes is unavailable, not zero.

panels.title: Services not yet run
panels.description: Inventoried services whose newest valid collector marker reports no workflow history. No matching rows means no service currently reports no history; no valid marker remains no data.

targets.expr: last_over_time({job="agent-cloud-conformance", step="none", status=~"^(no_history|has_history|history_incomplete)$"} | json | inventory_code=~"^(0|1|2)$" | marker_time_seconds=~"^[0-9]+$" | __error__="" | unwrap inventory_code | __error__="" [45m]) by (service) == 0

panels.title: Latest step status by service
panels.description: One row per service and workflow step. State is the newest report in the last 45 minutes, reduced across pass, fail, and skip before any failure filtering, and is shown as fail, pass, or skip. The collector re-emits retained state, so a recent collection gap does not erase the latest status. Services that have not run are listed separately. Workflow completion age and task provenance are shown in separate panels; historical failures are not current service health.

targets.expr: last_over_time({job="agent-cloud-conformance", step!="none"} | json state_code | unwrap state_code | __error__="" [45m]) by (service, step)

panels.title: Recent failed task snapshots
panels.description: Bounded history of failed workflow task records received in the last seven days, including error detail and the Semaphore task ID when present. The collector may repeat a historical failure across snapshots; these rows are historical workflow evidence, not current service health or a new-failure count. Use Latest step status by service for current recorded workflow state.

panels.title: History incomplete
panels.description: Services whose workflow history the collector could not read in full: a template's history filled the 1000-task window, so a step missing here may be older, not absent. NetBox keeps that step's last recorded status.

targets.expr: last_over_time({job="agent-cloud-conformance", step="none", status=~"^(no_history|has_history|history_incomplete)$"} | json | inventory_code=~"^(0|1|2)$" | marker_time_seconds=~"^[0-9]+$" | __error__="" | unwrap inventory_code | __error__="" [45m]) by (service) == 2

panels.title: Latest workflow completion age
panels.description: Smallest age in seconds among each service and step's newest completion record observed in the last 45 minutes. Unknown timestamps replace older known values before reduction, then are excluded from this newest-known aggregate. This measures workflow completion, not collector freshness.

targets.expr: min(last_over_time({job="agent-cloud-conformance", step!="none"} | json completed_at_seconds | label_format age_seconds=`{{if eq (.completed_at_seconds | default "unknown") "unknown"}}-1{{else}}{{sub (unixEpoch now) .completed_at_seconds}}{{end}}` | unwrap age_seconds | __error__="" [45m]) by (service, step) > -1)

panels.title: Latest workflow completion age by service and step
panels.description: Age in seconds for each service and step's newest completion record observed in the last 45 minutes. Match service and step with Latest step status by service to correlate state and age. Unknown or missing completion timestamps remain visible as Unknown; collector marker age is shown separately.

targets.expr: last_over_time({job="agent-cloud-conformance", step!="none"} | json completed_at_seconds | label_format age_seconds=`{{if eq (.completed_at_seconds | default "unknown") "unknown"}}-1{{else}}{{sub (unixEpoch now) .completed_at_seconds}}{{end}}` | unwrap age_seconds | __error__="" [45m]) by (service, step)

panels.title: Workflow completion and task provenance
panels.description: Collector snapshots of the latest workflow result by service and step, received in the last 45 minutes. Inspect task_id and completed_at_seconds in each record body: numeric values identify the workflow run and its completion time; retained state and missing or invalid completion times are explicitly unknown. Snapshot receipt time is not workflow completion time, and these records do not describe current service health.
